However, the Topology Auditor returned a high confidence mask (0.92), suggesting the object is topologically coherent despite the visual blur. I will maintain the severity at 2.0 as it affects realism but not structural integrity.

The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted 'slight compression' (0.2), which aligns with the general softness/noise in the image. No new catastrophic artifacts were found by experts.
